Microsoft’s gross margin percentage is directly comparable between FY2023 and FY2024 because both figures are for the consolidated company on the same fiscal year end (June 30) and prepared on a consistent basis, with no spinoff/divestiture adjustments mentioned in the provided excerpt.

1. Compute gross profit each year  
- FY2024 gross profit = Revenue − Cost of revenue  
  = $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008M [DOC-1]  
- FY2023 gross profit = Revenue − Cost of revenue  
  = $211,915M − $65,863M = $146,052M [DOC-1]  

2. Compute gross margin percentage each year  
- FY2024 gross margin % = $171,008M ÷ $245,122M ≈ 69.8% [DOC-1]  
- FY2023 gross margin % = $146,052M ÷ $211,915M ≈ 68.9% [DOC-1]  

3. Change in gross margin percentage  
- Change ≈ 69.8% − 68.9% ≈ 0.9 percentage points increase.

ANSWER: Microsoft’s gross margin improved by approximately 0.9 percentage points from FY2023 to FY2024.
